title: TensorPlate Desired State
description: Declarative reconciliation target consumed by `tensorplate-agent`. v0.1.0 supports exactly one active deployment per device; multi-deployment / fleet semantics land post-v0.1.0.

deployment_id.description: Stable identifier for this deployment intent. Distinct from `bundle_digest`: redeploying the same bundle bumps `deployment_id`.

bundle_digest.description: Content-addressed digest of the deployable bundle, e.g. `sha256:ab12...`. Verified by the agent before staging (V01-E08).

bundle_format_version.description: On-disk bundle format version. Bundles encoded against an older format require the agent to refuse promotion.

rollout.description: Rollout policy. v0.1.0 supports `immediate`; future versions may add `canary` / `staged`.

labels.description: Operator-supplied labels for status / observability filtering. Not interpreted by the runtime.
